topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Hey, I just caught wind of the shuffle at work, and I gotta tell you, it doesn't feel right, you know? I mean, you being moved over to another department—it’s like, yeah, maybe there are some perks, but it’s not the same. We’ve had some great times, figured out a lot of stuff together. I guess things change, and maybe this is one of those moments where we grow in new directions. Just promise me we won’t lose touch, okay? I value the times we chat and laugh and brainstorm. This place won’t be the same without you around as much. But hey, let’s make the best of it and catch up over coffee or something. What do you think?
